Naphthalene is still correctly ranked as 'largest' by heavy-atom count (10 vs 3), so the net fragment-selection OUTCOME here happens to be right, but for the wrong reason if read as 'solvent removal' -- the audit log must show DMSO as Kept-by-size, not Removed-as-solvent, so a caller can tell the difference.
